items.briefing:
Home batteries and solar systems are increasingly being flagged as a cybersecurity compliance concern for Australian organisations — if your workplace uses this technology, it may need to meet new security requirements. Separately, AI tools are creating challenges for traditional security controls, with experts warning that standard access management approaches may not be sufficient as AI becomes more embedded in workplace systems.

**Practical tip:** If your organisation uses smart energy systems like home or commercial batteries, check with your IT or facilities team whether those devices are included in your cybersecurity compliance reviews.
